title: Scuffling for work after the WPA
summary: After the WPA he played street jobs, had no steady job and played on the radio.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Well, after you got out of the WPA, did you play in the street any then? Oh yeah, I was playing.
I was playing in the street, a different band I loved. Sort of spotting, huh? Yeah, things were slow.
Mm-hmm. The job was being or something. Mm-hmm. And then, how long before you got a steady job on the street?
I had no steady job. I played on the radio. I mean, you weren't regular with any band?
